records.name: Alpine HCE-C2100RD HDR multi-view rear camera system
records.description: High Dynamic Range rear-view camera system designed for parking assistance with touchscreen operation. Alpine lists four selectable views (rear, panorama, corner and ground/top), automatic activation when reversing, HDR imaging, mirrored output and a 180° horizontal / 125° vertical field of view. Camera compatibility depends on the Alpine display and installation setup.

records.name: Alpine Status Hi-Res 6.5-inch 3-way component speaker set
records.description: Three-way component speaker set with a 170 mm door woofer, 96 mm midrange driver and 70 mm ring-radiator tweeter with 25 mm voice coil. Manufacturer states a 55 Hz–40 kHz bandwidth and includes speaker crossovers.

records.name: Alpine Halo 11 iLX-F115D 11-inch media receiver
records.description: 11-inch high-resolution WXGA touchscreen media receiver with a 1-DIN chassis. Manufacturer lists DAB+, wireless Apple CarPlay, wired Android Auto, USB video playback, Hi-Res Audio, Bluetooth hands-free and audio streaming, plus built-in Class-D amplification and sound tuning.
records.imageSource: Alpine official iLX-F115D product page gallery

records.name: Alpine R-Series R2-A60F 4-channel power amplifier
records.description: Four-channel R-Series amplifier rated by Alpine at 4 × 150 W RMS at 2 ohms. Manufacturer describes Hi-Res Audio compliance up to 45 kHz, a reduced installation footprint and low-distortion feedback/correction circuitry. Alpine identifies the manufacturer model as R2-A60F.

records.name: Alpine R-Series R2-W10D2 10-inch subwoofer with dual 2-ohm voice coils
records.description: 10-inch R-Series dual-voice-coil subwoofer with 2-ohm coils. Alpine lists 750 W RMS, 2,250 W peak handling, 26–200 Hz frequency response and 20 mm excursion. Features include HAMR surround, a Kevlar-reinforced cone, polypropylene/ceramic composite dust cap, double-stacked magnets and configuration jumpers.

records.name: Alpine R-Series R2-W12D4 12-inch subwoofer with dual 4-ohm voice coils
records.description: 12-inch R-Series dual-voice-coil subwoofer with dual 4-ohm coils. Alpine specifies 750 W RMS / 2,250 W peak power handling, 24–200 Hz frequency response, 84.5 dB sensitivity, a 65 mm voice coil and 20 mm X-Max. Features include a Kevlar-reinforced pulp cone, polypropylene/ceramic composite dust cap, HAMR surround, large double-stacked magnets, configuration jumpers and a twist-lock grille mount.
records.imageSource: Gentec International exact-model R2-W12D4 product image; distributor-hosted image candidate, not yet hosted-preview verified

records.name: Alpine S-Series S2-A55V 5-channel power amplifier
records.description: Five-channel S-Series amplifier rated at 4 × 60 W RMS plus 1 × 300 W RMS at 2 ohms. Alpine describes the four-channel section as Hi-Res Audio capable and the fifth channel as dedicated subwoofer power.

records.name: Alpine S-Series S2-S40C 10 cm 2-way component speaker set
records.description: 10 cm (4-inch) two-way component speaker set. Alpine lists a Hi-Res Audio-certified design, a polypropylene/glass-fibre/mica woofer cone, a 2 cm dome tweeter, in-line crossovers and installation adapters/spacers.

records.name: Alpine S-Series S2-S65 6.5-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: 6.5-inch coaxial two-way speaker set with integrated 1-inch tweeters. Alpine lists Hi-Res Audio certification up to 40 kHz, 80 W RMS / 240 W peak handling, 4-ohm impedance and 88 dB sensitivity. The design uses a polypropylene, glass-fibre and mica cone with HAMR surround.

records.name: Audison bit DMI MOST digital audio interface
records.description: Digital MOST interface for retaining integration with a vehicle's original infotainment system. Audison documents a MOST optical input, S/PDIF stereo PCM optical output and USB configuration; OEM volume, balance, tone and service signals such as hands-free, navigation and parking sensors are retained where supported. It does not decode proprietary Dolby/DTS multichannel formats.

records.name: Audison B-CON Hi-Res Bluetooth 5.0 receiver
records.description: Automotive Bluetooth 5.0 receiver with Hi-Res Audio Wireless certification. Supports LDAC streaming up to 24-bit/96 kHz on compatible Android devices, AAC on iOS, hands-free calling, RCA analogue outputs and Toslink optical digital connections, including optical pass-through.

records.name: Audison bit One HD Virtuoso 13-channel digital signal processor
records.description: High-definition car-audio DSP with 24-bit/96 kHz processing, 12 input channels and 13 output channels. Audison documents analogue and optical digital inputs, multi-channel signal routing, crossover filters, parametric equalisation and time alignment for OEM or aftermarket system integration.

records.name: Audison bit Ten 5-channel digital signal processor
records.description: Digital signal processor for tuning vehicle audio systems, with four input channels and five outputs, 24-bit/48 kHz processing, high- and low-level inputs, equalisation, crossover filtering and time alignment. Designed to integrate with factory or aftermarket audio sources.

records.name: Audison bit Tune automatic audio calibration tool
records.description: Automatic calibration and diagnostic tool suite for Audison bit processors. Manufacturer describes assistance with time alignment, equalisation and level setup, plus checks for common installation issues such as channel inversion, phase errors and missing signal.

records.name: Audison Prima AP4 D 4-channel Class-D amplifier
records.description: Four-channel Class-D amplifier rated at 4 × 130 W RMS at 2 ohms (520 W total). It can also be bridged for 2 × 260 W RMS at 4 ohms and includes high- and low-level inputs for integration with different source units.

records.name: AF M12.14 bit 12-channel DSP amplifier
records.description: Twelve-channel Class-D DSP amplifier rated at 12 × 60 W RMS at 4 ohms or 12 × 90 W RMS at 2 ohms. It combines 24-bit/96 kHz DSP processing with a 40 kHz audio band, bridgeable channel pairs and OEM/aftermarket input integration.

records.name: AF M8.14 bit 8-channel DSP amplifier
records.description: Eight-channel Class-D DSP amplifier rated at 8 × 90 W RMS at 4 ohms or 8 × 140 W RMS at 2 ohms. The integrated DSP operates at 24-bit/96 kHz with audio bandwidth up to 40 kHz; six processed preamp outputs extend system configuration options.

records.name: AF C8.14 bit 8-channel DSP amplifier
records.description: Eight-channel Class-D DSP amplifier rated at 8 × 65 W RMS at 4 ohms or 8 × 100 W RMS at 2 ohms. Its integrated 24-bit/96 kHz DSP supports a 40 kHz audio band and bridgeable channel pairs for flexible system layouts.

records.name: AF M5.11 bit 5-channel DSP amplifier
records.description: Five-channel Class-D DSP amplifier rated at 4 × 100 W plus 1 × 400 W RMS at 4 ohms, or 4 × 150 W plus 1 × 600 W RMS at 2 ohms. Integrated 24-bit/96 kHz DSP provides up to 11 processed channels, with optional preamp outputs and bridgeable channel pairs.

records.name: AF C4.10 bit 4-channel DSP amplifier
records.description: Four-channel Class-D DSP amplifier rated at 4 × 90 W RMS at 4 ohms or 4 × 150 W RMS at 2 ohms. Its integrated 24-bit/96 kHz DSP supports a 40 kHz audio band, 10 processed channels and bridgeable channel pairs.

records.name: Audison F2O digital input expansion board
records.description: Digital input expansion board for compatible Audison AF bit DSP amplifiers. The card adds either a coaxial S/PDIF input or a second Toslink S/PDIF input, selectable using its onboard switch.

records.name: Audison F4IN analogue input expansion board
records.description: Analogue input expansion board for compatible Audison AF bit DSP amplifiers. It adds four high-voltage analogue inputs to the amplifier's native eight, supporting input sensitivity up to 32 VRMS for integration with higher-voltage OEM systems.

records.name: Audison APL2 link cable for AP4 D and AP1 D amplifiers
records.description: Connection cable designed to link Audison AP5.9 bit or AP4.9 bit amplifiers to the AP4 D or AP1 D amplifier. Confirm the amplifier pairing and cable fitment before ordering.

records.name: Audison APBMW ReAMP 1 BMW amplifier replacement T-harness
records.description: Plug-and-play T-harness for installing compatible Audison AP bit or AF bit amplifiers in specified BMW vehicles with Hi-Fi 676 or low-level Harman/Kardon 674 systems. The harness uses the vehicle's 42-pin connector. ReAMP 1, ReAMP 2 and AFBMW ReAMP 3 have different pinouts and are not interchangeable; vehicle/system verification is essential.

records.name: Audison APBMW BIAMP 2 BMW/MINI plug-and-play T-harness
records.description: Plug-and-play T-harness for compatible BMW and MINI vehicles without a factory amplifier. It routes the OEM front-speaker signal to an AP bit amplifier and returns amplified outputs to the front midrange speakers and under-seat subwoofer without cutting the factory wiring. Manufacturer specifies a pair of 450 cm cables; vehicle compatibility must be checked before sale.

records.name: Audison AV 1.1 28 mm tweeter set
records.description: 28 mm Tetolon-fibre dome tweeter set with a CCAW voice coil and neodymium magnet. Audison lists 180 W peak handling, 4-ohm impedance, 92 dB sensitivity and a 1.2–22 kHz frequency response. The set includes protective grilles.

records.name: Audison VOCE II AV 1.1 II Hi-Res tweeter set
records.description: High-resolution 28 mm Tetolon-dome tweeter set from the Audison VOCE II range. The manufacturer describes a redesigned rear chamber and magnetic assembly for improved damping and lower crossover operation, with response extending up to 40 kHz. Installation faceplates and grilles are included.

records.name: Audison AV 3.0 70 mm midrange speaker
records.description: 70 mm (3-inch) 4-ohm midrange driver with a neodymium motor. Audison lists 100 W peak / 50 W continuous handling, 93 dB sensitivity and a 200 Hz–14 kHz response. The compact driver includes a protective grille.

records.name: Audison VOCE II AV 3.0 II 70 mm midrange speaker
records.description: 70 mm VOCE II midrange driver with a semi-pressed paper and cotton-fibre cone, neodymium motor and die-cast aluminium basket. Audison lists 100 W peak / 50 W continuous handling, 90 dB sensitivity and a 160 Hz–13 kHz response, with OEM-style and Faston connection options.

records.name: Audison AV 6.5 165 mm woofer
records.description: 165 mm (6.5-inch) 4-ohm woofer from the Audison VOCE range. Manufacturer specifications list 200 W peak / 100 W continuous handling, 91 dB sensitivity and a 50 Hz–7 kHz response. The design uses a cotton-fibre pressed-paper cone, butyl-rubber surround and CCAW voice coil.

records.name: Audison VOCE II AV 6.5 P II 165 mm mid-bass woofer
records.description: 165 mm (6.5-inch) VOCE II mid-bass woofer rated at 150 W continuous / 300 W peak, 4 ohms and 91 dB sensitivity. Features include a 40 mm CCAW voice coil, semi-pressed pulp cone with cotton fibres, die-cast aluminium basket and both OEM-style and Faston connectors.

records.name: Audison APBX 8 DS 8-inch sealed subwoofer enclosure
records.description: Loaded 8-inch subwoofer enclosure with dual 4-ohm voice coils, 250 W continuous / 500 W peak handling and an 8.5-litre sealed cabinet. Audison's reversible 2S² design supports down-firing or up-firing installation; the SSP terminal block allows quick impedance configuration and disconnection.

records.name: Audison Prima APK 130 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: Two-way 130 mm (5-inch) component kit comprising an AP 1 tweeter, AP 5 woofer and crossover. Audison lists 75 W continuous / 225 W peak handling at 4 ohms, with a tweeter-level adjustment and compact OEM-oriented installation components.

records.name: Audison Prima APK 165 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: Two-way 165 mm (6.5-inch) component kit comprising an AP 1 tweeter, AP 6.5 woofer and crossover. Audison lists 100 W continuous / 300 W peak handling at 4 ohms; the compact crossover includes a tweeter-level selector for different installation positions.

records.name: Audison Prima APK 165P 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: Two-way 165 mm (6.5-inch) component kit comprising an AP 1P tweeter, AP 6.5P woofer and separate compact crossovers. Audison lists 115 W continuous / 345 W peak handling at 4 ohms, with AIF mounting faceplates and installation options for OEM locations.

records.name: Audison Prima APK 165 Ohm2 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: Two-way 165 mm (6.5-inch) component kit with AP 1 tweeter, AP 6.5 Ohm2 woofer and dedicated tweeter/woofer crossovers. The 2-ohm kit is rated at 100 W continuous / 300 W peak and is designed for compatible low-impedance amplifier configurations.

records.name: Audison APBMW K4E BMW 4-inch 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: BMW-specific 4-inch two-way component kit with a midrange driver, Tetolon-dome tweeter and crossover. Audison lists 100 W peak / 50 W continuous handling at 4 ohms; the water-repellent pressed-paper cone and Plug-and-Play connectors are designed for the specified BMW/MINI factory locations. Confirm exact vehicle and basket fitment before sale.

records.name: Audison APBMW K4M BMW 4-inch 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: BMW-MINI-specific 2-way speaker upgrade kit with a 100 mm (4 in) midrange woofer, 29 mm Tetolon dome tweeter and Plug & Play crossover/connectors. Rated at 100 W peak / 50 W continuous with 4-ohm impedance. Includes tweeter support and a 30 cm extension; confirm vehicle mounting and compatibility before ordering.

records.name: Audison Prima APK 690 6x9-inch 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: 6x9-inch two-way component kit with AP 1 tweeter, AP 690 woofer and dedicated crossover. Audison lists 100 W continuous / 300 W peak handling at 4 ohms. The elliptical woofer and compact tweeter crossover are intended for vehicle doors designed for 6x9-inch speakers.

records.name: Audison Prima APK 163 3-way component speaker kit
records.description: Three-way 4-ohm component kit comprising AP 1 tweeter, AP 4 midrange, AP 6.5 woofer and dedicated crossovers. Audison lists 125 W continuous / 375 W peak handling. Separate compact crossovers are designed to simplify OEM speaker replacement and avoid routing extra cables through the doors.

records.name: Audison APX 4 4-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: 4-inch (100 mm) two-way coaxial speaker with a concentric tweeter for a single acoustic emission point. Audison lists 40 W continuous / 120 W peak handling at 4 ohms, 91 dB sensitivity and an 80 Hz–23 kHz response; the shallow basket is intended to support OEM-style installations.

records.name: Audison APX 5 5-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: 5-inch (130 mm) two-way coaxial speaker with a concentric tweeter and shallow Triple Wave surround. Audison lists 50 W continuous / 150 W peak handling at 4 ohms, 93 dB sensitivity and a 70 Hz–23 kHz response.

records.name: Audison APX 6.5 6.5-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: 6.5-inch (165 mm) two-way coaxial speaker with a concentric tweeter. Audison lists 70 W continuous / 210 W peak handling at 4 ohms, 94 dB tweeter sensitivity and a 60 Hz–23 kHz response; the shallow basket and low-profile design support OEM integration.

records.name: Audison APX 690 6x9-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: 6x9-inch elliptical coaxial speaker with a 40 mm horn-loaded dome tweeter and a dedicated super-tweeter. Audison lists 100 W continuous / 300 W peak handling at 4 ohms, 96 dB sensitivity and a 40 Hz–23 kHz response.

records.name: Audison APX 570 5x7-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: 5x7-inch elliptical two-way coaxial speaker with a concentric tweeter and shallow Triple Wave surround. Audison lists 70 W continuous / 210 W peak handling at 4 ohms, 93 dB sensitivity and a 60 Hz–23 kHz response.

records.name: Audison APBMW X4E BMW 4-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: BMW/MINI-specific 4-inch coaxial speaker for vehicles where a two-way front system cannot be fitted or for rear-speaker upgrades. Audison lists 40 W continuous / 80 W peak handling at 4 ohms, with a water-repellent pressed-paper cone, Tetolon-dome tweeter and dedicated Plug-and-Play basket/connectors. Confirm exact vehicle fitment.

records.name: Audison APBMW X4M BMW 4-inch coaxial 2-way speakers
records.description: BMW/MINI-specific 4-inch coaxial speaker designed for rear-speaker upgrades or vehicles where a front two-way system cannot be installed. Audison lists 40 W continuous / 80 W peak handling at 4 ohms, with a water-repellent pressed-paper cone, Tetolon-dome tweeter and vehicle-specific basket/connectors. Confirm exact vehicle fitment.

records.name: Audison APBMW A4E BMW speaker installation accessory kit
records.description: BMW-specific installation accessory kit designed to fit Audison midrange and coaxial speakers in vehicle models that use non-standard factory mounting fixings. The exact vehicle and speaker combination must be checked before supply.

records.name: Audison VOCE AV K6 2-way component speaker kit
records.description: Two-way 4-ohm component kit comprising the AV 1.1 Tetolon-dome tweeter, AV 6.5 woofer and dedicated crossover. Audison lists 125 W continuous / 250 W peak handling, a 50 Hz–22 kHz response and crossover-level adjustment for installation tuning.

records.name: Audison AV X6.5 6.5-inch coaxial speaker
records.description: 6.5-inch (165 mm) 4-ohm coaxial speaker with a Tetolon-dome tweeter and dedicated on-wire crossover. Audison describes Orientable High Frequency Tuning to adjust high-frequency dispersion, a cotton-fibre pressed-paper cone, CCAW voice coil and Triple Wave butyl-rubber surround. Manufacturer lists 200 W peak handling.

records.name: Focal HILO V3 high-to-low level signal converter
records.description: High-to-low signal converter that converts an amplified factory head-unit output into a low-level stereo signal for an aftermarket amplifier while retaining the original radio and vehicle controls. Focal describes full ground separation to reduce interference and selectable AC/DC signal detection for compatibility with factory audio sources.

records.name: Focal P 20 FE 8-inch Flax subwoofer
records.description: 20 cm (7.9-inch) 4-ohm subwoofer using Focal's Flax sandwich cone. Rated at 250 W RMS / 500 W maximum, with a 39 Hz–500 Hz response and 82.5 dB sensitivity. The manufacturer specifies a 117 mm mounting depth and recommends a sealed 10–15 litre or bass-reflex 10–20 litre enclosure.

records.name: JVC CS-DR162 6.5-inch 2-way coaxial speakers
records.description: 16 cm (6.5-inch) two-way coaxial speaker pair with a PP-and-mica woofer cone, balanced-dome tweeter and full-cover grilles. JVC lists 50 W RMS / 300 W peak handling, 4-ohm impedance, 88 dB sensitivity and an 88 Hz–22 kHz response.

records.name: JVC KW-M590BT 6.8-inch multimedia receiver
records.description: 6.8-inch WSVGA capacitive-touch multimedia receiver with wired Apple CarPlay, wired Android Auto, USB screen mirroring, Bluetooth hands-free/audio streaming and a short chassis. Audio features include a 13-band EQ, time alignment, 2.5 V front/rear/subwoofer pre-outs and a rear-view camera input. JVC specifies 22 W × 4 full-bandwidth output and 50 W × 4 maximum output.
records.imageSource: Crutchfield exact-model KW-M590BT product image; retailer-hosted image candidate, not yet hosted-preview verified

records.name: Kenwood DMX5023DABS 6.8-inch DAB+ multimedia receiver
records.description: 6.8-inch WSVGA capacitive-touch multimedia receiver with wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, USB smartphone mirroring, built-in DAB+ radio, Bluetooth hands-free/audio streaming and rear-camera input with parking guidelines. Includes 13-band EQ, digital time alignment, 2.5 V front/rear/subwoofer pre-outs and a short chassis; rated at 22 W × 4 continuous and 50 W × 4 maximum.

records.name: Kicker 43C104 10-inch Comp 4-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 10-inch single-voice-coil Comp subwoofer rated at 150 W RMS recommended amplifier power and 300 W peak. The 4-ohm driver is designed for sealed or ported enclosures and provides an entry-level Kicker bass upgrade.

records.name: Kicker 43C124 12-inch Comp 4-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 12-inch single-voice-coil Comp subwoofer rated at 150 W RMS recommended amplifier power and 300 W peak. The 4-ohm driver is designed for sealed or ported enclosures and provides a value-focused bass upgrade.

records.name: Kicker 43C84 8-inch Comp 4-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 8-inch single-voice-coil Comp subwoofer with a 4-ohm impedance. Kicker lists 50–100 W RMS recommended amplifier power and 200 W peak handling, with a 30–500 Hz frequency response and compact enclosure requirements.

records.name: Kicker 44L7S122 12-inch Solo-Baric L7S 2-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 12-inch square-cone Solo-Baric L7S subwoofer with dual 2-ohm voice coils. Kicker recommends 750 W RMS amplifier power and lists 1,500 W peak handling. Features include a polypropylene cone, SoloKon 360-degree back bracing, corner ribs, a cast-aluminium basket and perimeter venting.

records.name: Kicker CXA1200.1 1200-watt mono Class-D amplifier
records.description: Mono Class-D subwoofer amplifier delivering up to 1,200 W to a single bass channel and stable operation at 1 ohm. Includes variable KickEQ bass boost, a 12 dB crossover, 24 dB subsonic filter, high-level input support up to 40 V and RCA pass-through outputs.

records.name: Kicker CXA360.4 4-channel full-range amplifier
records.description: Four-channel Class-AB full-range amplifier rated at 65 W × 4 at 4 ohms or 90 W × 4 at 2 ohms, with 180 W × 2 bridged at 4 ohms. Includes variable KickEQ bass boost, 12 dB crossovers and FIT+ high-level integration for factory radios.

records.name: Kicker CXA400.1 mono Class-D amplifier
records.description: Mono Class-D subwoofer amplifier rated up to 400 W on one bass channel and stable at 1 ohm. Includes KickEQ variable bass boost, 12 dB crossover, 24 dB subsonic filter, high-level input support up to 40 V and RCA pass-through outputs.

records.name: Kicker CXA660.5 5-channel amplifier
records.description: Five-channel amplifier combining four Class-AB full-range channels with a Class-D subwoofer channel. Kicker lists up to 90 W × 4 for the full-range channels and 300 W for the sub channel at 2 ohms. Includes variable crossovers, KickEQ bass boost, a subsonic filter and FIT+ factory-radio integration.

records.name: Kicker 48CWR104 10-inch CompR 4-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 10-inch CompR dual-voice-coil subwoofer with a 4-ohm configuration. Kicker recommends 400 W RMS amplifier power; the design uses Forced-Air Cooling and an advanced suspension/heat-management system for consistent bass performance in sealed or ported enclosures.

records.name: Kicker 48CWR124 12-inch CompR 4-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 12-inch CompR dual-voice-coil subwoofer with a 4-ohm configuration. Kicker recommends 500 W RMS amplifier power and lists 1,000 W peak handling. Designed for sealed or ported enclosures, with an advanced suspension and heat-management system.

records.name: Kicker 48CWRT102 10-inch CompRT 2-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 10-inch shallow-mount CompRT subwoofer with dual 2-ohm voice coils. Kicker recommends 400 W RMS amplifier power and lists 800 W peak handling. The low-profile design is intended for installations with limited mounting depth.

records.name: Kicker 48CWRT104 10-inch CompRT 4-ohm subwoofer
records.description: 10-inch shallow-mount CompRT subwoofer with dual 4-ohm voice coils. Kicker recommends 400 W RMS amplifier power and lists 800 W peak handling. The low-profile design is intended for installations with limited mounting depth.

records.name: Pioneer DMH-AP6650BT 9-inch touchscreen multimedia receiver
records.description: 9-inch WSVGA capacitive multimedia receiver (1024 × 600) with wireless and wired Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, built-in Bluetooth 5.3 and 5 GHz Wi-Fi, WebLink Browser/Cast, 13-band EQ, DSP, time alignment and 3-way network mode. Includes 3 × 4 V RCA pre-outs, rear-camera input, USB quick charge (1.5 A) and 50 W × 4 MOSFET output. Optional 360° camera requires a compatible adapter; OEM CAN functions require compatible Hiworld, Raise or SimpleSoft interfaces.

records.name: Kicker KW16400 16AWG K-Series Speaker Wire (sold per metre)
records.description: Kicker K-Series 16AWG speaker wire, available by the metre and cut from the KW16400 400ft spool. The square Frost Blue conductor identifies positive and the rounded Frost Clear conductor identifies negative. Both PVC-insulated conductors are silver-tinned and oxygen-free for signal transfer and sonic accuracy.
